item.title: Gina Carano Comes Out of MMA Retirement to Face Ronda Rousey in Netflix Fight Night
item.description: Gina Carano is coming out of a 17-year MMA retirement this May, facing Ronda Rousey live on Netflix in her first official fight since 2009. The post Gina Carano Comes Out of MMA Retirement to Face Ronda Rousey in Netflix Fight Night appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Forbes Names Women’s Sports Icon Billie Jean King to 250 Greatest Innovators List
item.description: Forbes named Billie Jean King to this year's Innovator 250 List, recognizing the WTA founder for transforming women's professional sports. The post Forbes Names Women’s Sports Icon Billie Jean King to 250 Greatest Innovators List appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: USA Hockey Crushes Olympic Competition, Books Gold Medal Game Rematch vs. Canada
item.description: USA hockey will be on the Olympic podium, with the undefeated US punching a ticket to a gold medal rematch with rival Canada this week. The post USA Hockey Crushes Olympic Competition, Books Gold Medal Game Rematch vs. Canada appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: South Carolina Women’s Basketball Coach Dawn Staley Earns 500th Victory in Win Over LSU
item.description: South Carolina beat LSU 79-72 on Saturday, securing head coach Dawn Staley her 500th win with the SEC women's basketball titan. The post South Carolina Women’s Basketball Coach Dawn Staley Earns 500th Victory in Win Over LSU appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Unrivaled 1v1 Tournament Crowns Chelsea Gray 2026 Champion
item.description: The Unrivaled 1v1 tournament wrapped on Saturday, as Rose BC guard Chelsea Gray defeated Mist BC's Allisha Gray to win the 2026 title. The post Unrivaled 1v1 Tournament Crowns Chelsea Gray 2026 Champion appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: WNBA Star Breanna Stewart Signs with EuroLeague Team Fenerbahçe as CBA Talks Linger
item.description: New York Liberty standout Breanna Stewart is returning to the EuroLeague in April, joining her previous Turkish team Fenerbahçe for their 2026 title run. item.title: U.S. Skier Mikaela Shiffrin Goes for Gold After String of Olympic Stumbles
item.description: US skier Mikaela Shiffrin has one last shot at hardware at the 2026 Winter Olympics, as the slalom star looks to snap her eight-race medal drought on Wednesday. item.title: ISU Issues Statement After Adeliia Petrosian’s Russian Coach Attends Olympic Practice
item.description: The International Skating Union issued a statement, after Russian coach Eteri Tutberidze met with neutral Olympic athlete Adeliia Petrosian. The post ISU Issues Statement After Adeliia Petrosian’s Russian Coach Attends Olympic Practice appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Decorated U.S. Bobsled Star Elana Meyers Taylor Wins 1st Olympic Gold Medal
item.description: Bobsled icon Elana Meyers Taylor tied the US women's Olympic medal record in historic fashion, earning her 1st-ever gold — and sixth overall — medal on Monday. The post Decorated U.S. Bobsled Star Elana Meyers Taylor Wins 1st Olympic Gold Medal appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Alexandra Eala Ousts Jasmine Paolini from 2026 Dubai Tennis Championships in Straight Sets
item.description: Alexandra Eala defeated world No. 8 Jasmine Paolini 6-1, 7-6(5), advancing to the third round in Dubai with her third career Top 10 win. The post Alexandra Eala Ousts Jasmine Paolini from 2026 Dubai Tennis Championships in Straight Sets appeared first on Just Women's Sports.
